values.value: Create missing Asset for active Subscription (account {accountName})

1. Open the active Subscription {primaryRecordId} on {accountName} — bills {quantity} of {productName} at {unitPrice}. 2. No Asset record exists; downstream entitlement and asset-tracking automation will silently skip this customer. 3. Create the Asset record manually with the correct quantity, install date, and account linkage. 4. Inspect the contract-activation Flow / Apex that should auto-generate Assets from Subscriptions — it's failing or not installed. 5. Run a one-off backfill query: subscriptions without matching Assets; fix as a batch if multiple.
Asset record created and linked to the Subscription.
